3d. The Female Genital Organs

(Organa Genitalia Muliebria)
The female genital organs consist of an internal and an external group. The 
internal organs
 are situated within the pelvis, and consist of the 
ovaries,
 the 
uterine tubes,
 the 
uterus,
 and the 
vagina.
 The 
external organs
 are placed below the urogenital diaphragm and below and in front of the pubic arch. They comprise the 
mons pubis,
 the 
labia majora et minora pudendi,
 the 
clitoris,
 the 
bulbus vestibuli,
 and the 
greater vestibular glands.
